Timothée Chalamet approached his performance in Dune: Part Two as a transformation from reluctant heir to commanding leader. Director Denis Villeneuve worked closely with him to gradually change Paul Atreides’ voice, posture, and presence across the film so the character’s rise to power would feel believable.

Dune: Part Two (2024), directed by Denis Villeneuve, starring Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson. A monumental sci-fi epic where Paul Atreides embraces his destiny among the Fremen and leads a rebellion that could reshape the fate of Arrakis.
